clinic.heroSubtitle: Restore your smile, regain full chewing function, and enjoy lasting confidence with comprehensive full mouth restoration. Our board-certified prosthodontists specialize in rehabilitating extensive dental damage, offering advanced solutions like implants, crowns, and custom prosthetics to rebuild your oral health, aesthetics, and bite harmony. Experience a revitalized life with a beautiful, functional smile built to last.

treatmentJourney.title: Comprehensive Consultation & Records
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a thorough evaluation, including full records, CBCT scans, and detailed photography to understand your unique needs and goals for full mouth rehabilitation.

treatmentJourney.title: Collaborative Digital Treatment Plan
treatmentJourney.description: We create a personalized digital treatment plan, complete with mockups of your final smile and bite, ensuring you are an active participant in designing your ideal outcome.

treatmentJourney.title: Foundation Phase Preparations
treatmentJourney.description: This stage involves any necessary extractions, implant placements, and foundational gum or bone work to prepare your mouth for the upcoming restorative phases.

treatmentJourney.title: Provisional Restorations & Testing
treatmentJourney.description: You'll receive temporary restorations to test your new bite, aesthetics, and overall function, allowing for adjustments and ensuring comfort before permanent placement.

treatmentJourney.title: Custom Fabrication & Final Delivery
treatmentJourney.description: Once perfected, your custom lab-fabricated permanent restorations are meticulously crafted and then precisely delivered, bringing your reconstructed smile to life.

treatmentJourney.title: Long-Term Maintenance & Care
treatmentJourney.description: We provide a comprehensive long-term maintenance plan, including nightguards, regular hygiene visits, and protective care to ensure the longevity and health of your new smile.

faqItems.question: How long does a full mouth restoration take?
faqItems.answer: The duration of a full mouth restoration varies greatly depending on the complexity of your case and the specific treatments involved. We'll outline a detailed timeline during your personalized treatment planning phase.

faqItems.question: Will I have to be without teeth at any point during treatment?
faqItems.answer: Our goal is to ensure you always have functional and aesthetic provisional restorations. We plan carefully to minimize any time you might be without teeth, allowing you to maintain your daily life with confidence.

faqItems.question: Why choose a prosthodontist for full mouth restoration?
faqItems.answer: Prosthodontists are specialists in complex dental and facial conditions, with extensive training in restoring and replacing teeth. Their expertise ensures the highest standard of comprehensive care for full mouth reconstruction.

faqItems.question: How do you ensure my comfort during long appointments?
faqItems.answer: We prioritize your comfort and prompt attention throughout your treatment. Our staff is dedicated to making your experience as pleasant as possible, and we discuss options to manage any anxiety during your consultation.

faqItems.question: Do you offer solutions for bite problems and TMJ issues?
faqItems.answer: Yes, our practice offers a full scope of occlusal and aesthetic treatment. Restoring proper bite alignment is a foundational component of full mouth rehabilitation, and we address TMJ concerns within our treatment plans.

faqItems.question: How much does full mouth reconstruction cost?
faqItems.answer: The cost of full mouth reconstruction is highly individualized, depending on the scope of work needed. We provide a detailed treatment plan and discuss all financial aspects transparently during your consultation.

doctor.name: Dr. Louis F. DeSantis
doctor.bio: With over 40 years of dental and prosthodontic experience, Dr. Louis F. DeSantis is Staten Island's first Board-Certified Prosthodontist. He is a former Associate Professor in Post Doctoral Prosthodontics and a national lecturer. Dr. DeSantis is dedicated to providing the ultimate restorative, implant, and aesthetic dental care, ensuring patients receive the highest standard of treatment for complex oral health needs. His expertise is coupled with a genuine concern for patient comfort and achieving natural-looking, functional results.

reviews.name: Lisa P.
reviews.text: Wonderful Dr. & staff, so grateful to have found such a skilled expert, professional & pleasant dentist. It was so refreshing to find a dentist who assessed and corrected a dental issue I was having for several years which previous dentists were incapable of doing. I am so very pleased with the excellent dental work I received from Dr DeSantis. I highly recommend.

reviews.name: Lynn R.
reviews.text: I can’t say enough great things about my dental experience with Dr. Louis DeSantis and his staff. He’s a professional and compassionate prosthodontist which I was in need of. I had dental work done which included implants and Dr. DeSantis did all the work himself; I didn’t need a second dentist. Implants can be very costly but I found his fees were very reasonable

reviews.name: Gail J.
reviews.text: Thrilled beyond words with the care i have received. Doctor is a magician; absolutely painless! His work is perfection. Professional, skilled and compassionate, can't say enough glowing compliments. Staff are wonderful! Entire experience so exceeded my expectations. So glad i found them!

reviews.name: Cate M.
reviews.text: When I began coming to the Dr. I was fairly traumatized by going to other dentists who, frankly, didn’t know what they were doing. Dr. DeSantis couldn’t be further from that. He’s the most skilled professional with the kindest heart. His work is impeccable - my teeth look beautiful, and it’s hard to believe he does it all with the gentlest touch, no pain whatsoever.

reviews.name: Sheila C.
reviews.text: Best Dentist ever, very skilled and very talented. My bridge he told me might last 10 years actually lasted 22 years! And it would have lasted even longer if I didn’t have a tooth decay. The new ones are even prettier. Also he’s the best Novocain giver. He’s very confident and steady when giving it. I hardly feel any pain.

reviews.name: Myriam D.
reviews.text: Dr Desantis was extremely helpful, very friendly, and took me in on very short notice for a complicated procedure. When he did the procedure, all of my pain went away, and it was if I was back to normal as if no Work was even done. I would highly recommend him for anyone who needs anything done with their dental needs. Thank you Dr. Desantis!
